cases.name: what_is_fermix
expectations: explains Fermix as an Elixir-native agent platform that runs as one OS daemon

cases.name: builtins_vs_skills
cases.prompt: What is the difference between a Fermix built-in tool and a skill?
expectations: distinguishes keyless built-ins seeded into the capability registry from SKILL.md instruction packages loaded via skill_view/skill_run

cases.name: change_model_or_provider
cases.prompt: How do I change which model or provider Fermix uses?
expectations: points to config.toml [fermix_core.agent] provider and [fermix_core.providers.<name>], and notes the change applies on restart

cases.name: what_can_tools_touch
cases.prompt: What can Fermix's tools read and write on my machine?
expectations: explains the sandbox gates file/exec built-ins with modes (strict/standard/open) and always-denied protected paths

cases.name: connect_telegram
cases.prompt: How do I connect Fermix to Telegram?
expectations: names the bot token from @BotFather /newbot and the numeric Telegram user id (from @userinfobot, not /whoami) as the two values, entered in the Mac app's Settings > Channels > Telegram or browser setup on Linux, then a restart and pressing Start (/start) in the bot's chat

cases.name: voice_call_uses_chat_link
cases.prompt: If I paste a link in the Mac chat and then ask about it out loud on a GPT-Live voice call, can Fermix use it? And can I keep calls out of the chat?
expectations: says that by default a GPT-Live call's tasks run in the Mac chat's own conversation, so a task asked aloud can read the pasted link, and that Settings > Voice > Voice calls join the chat set to No (conversation = "private") keeps each call apart from the chat

cases.name: typed_message_during_voice_call
cases.prompt: While I'm on a GPT-Live voice call, if I paste a link in the Mac chat, will Fermix reply to it in the chat? And can it see what I said on the call?
expectations: says the typed message's turn knows a call is up: it answers in writing when the message asks for something or needs an answer, and otherwise ends with no reply (nothing is shown), and that it can read the call in progress (start, tasks, the newest speech) with voice_call_context, which is offered only during a call in the chat
